flowlu_opportunity_create.label: Create Opportunity
flowlu_opportunity_create.description: Creates a CRM opportunity (deal) in Flowlu.

name.label: Name
name.description: Opportunity name, such as "Website redesign for Acme".

budget.label: Amount
budget.description: Opportunity value in the portal currency, such as 1500.

pipeline_id.label: Pipeline ID
pipeline_id.description: Sales pipeline. Get IDs from List Reference Values with entity pipelines. Numeric ID such as "42".

pipeline_stage_id.label: Pipeline Stage ID
pipeline_stage_id.description: Stage in the pipeline, checked against it before saving. Creating needs Pipeline ID too; updating without Pipeline ID uses the pipeline the opportunity is already in. Get IDs from List Reference Values with entity pipeline_stages and parent_id = the pipeline ID. Numeric ID such as "42".

source_id.label: Source ID
source_id.description: Where the opportunity came from. Get IDs from List Reference Values with entity opportunity_sources. Numeric ID such as "42".

assignee_id.description: User responsible for the opportunity. Get user IDs from List Users. Numeric ID such as "42".

start_date.label: Start Date
start_date.description: Start date, such as "2026-10-01". Only the date part is used.

deadline.label: Expected Close Date
deadline.description: Planned close date, such as "2026-11-30". Only the date part is used.

contact_name.label: Contact Name
contact_name.description: Free-text contact name stored on the opportunity (not a CRM link).

contact_email.description: Free-text contact email stored on the opportunity.

contact_phone.description: Free-text contact phone stored on the opportunity.

contact_position.description: Free-text job title stored on the opportunity.

organization_id.description: CRM organization to link to the opportunity. Numeric ID from Find CRM Accounts.

contact_id.label: Contact ID
contact_id.description: CRM contact to link to the opportunity. Numeric ID from Find CRM Accounts.

flowlu_task_create.label: Create Task

type.label: Type
type.description: Task type. Leave empty for a regular task (Flowlu default).

plan_start_date.label: Start Date
plan_start_date.description: Planned start, ISO 8601 such as "2026-10-01T09:00:00Z". Sent as "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss" in the DopplerTask server's time zone; Flowlu reads it in the portal timezone.

deadline.label: Deadline
deadline.description: End date, ISO 8601 such as "2026-10-05T17:00:00Z". Sent as "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss" in the DopplerTask server's time zone; Flowlu reads it in the portal timezone.

responsible_id.description: User who does the task. Get user IDs from List Users. Numeric ID such as "42".

owner_id.label: Owner User ID
owner_id.description: User who owns (set) the task. Get user IDs from List Users. Numeric ID such as "42".

project_id.description: Links the task to this project. Get IDs from Find Projects. Numeric ID such as "42".

crm_account_id.description: Links the task to a CRM contact or organization. Get IDs from Find CRM Accounts. Numeric ID such as "42".

parent_id.label: Parent Task ID
parent_id.description: Makes this a subtask of that task. Numeric ID such as "42".

deadline_allowchange.label: Assignee Can Change Deadline
deadline_allowchange.description: Yes lets the assignee move the deadline. Leave empty to keep the current setting.

task_checkbyowner.label: Needs Owner Approval
task_checkbyowner.description: Yes means the owner must approve the task before it is completed. Leave empty to keep the current setting.
